profile.name: release
profile.note: CI measurement overrides; repository default release LTO remains thin

timing: Instant wall time including process startup and captured stdout/stderr; comparison and artifact writes excluded
cache_policy: No cache drops. Verification runs precede one warmup per executable, then seven alternating measurement rounds. Shared fixture and OS page cache are warm.
limitations: Selected SHA-1 read workloads on a shared hosted Linux runner; no universal speed or memory claim; reference Git uses its packaged build configuration.
